protocol.question: Which support category best matches this customer message?

intent_definitions.billing: Charges, invoices, payments, receipts, refunds, and unexpected fees.
intent_definitions.technical support: Product failures, crashes, errors, broken features, synchronization, or other technical problems.
intent_definitions.sales: Pre-purchase questions about pricing, quotes, demos, plans, licenses, or volume purchases.
intent_definitions.account access: Login, password, authentication, locked-account, or two-factor-access problems.
intent_definitions.cancellation: Requests to end, discontinue, or stop renewal of an existing subscription or service.
intent_definitions.shipping: Delivery, parcels, tracking, courier status, delivery address, or arrival-time questions.
